description: The standard package manager for SmartOS, but also usable on NetBSD or any OS that uses pkgsrc. (Home: http://pkgin.net/).

parameters.name: clean
parameters.description: Clean packages cache. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Force package reinstall. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: full_upgrade
parameters.description: Upgrade all packages to their newer versions. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of package to install/remove; Multiple names may be given, separated by commas.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Intended state of the package. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: update_cache
parameters.description: Update repository database. Can be run with other steps or on its own. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: upgrade
parameters.description: Upgrade main packages to their newer versions. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Install package foo
  community.general.pkgin:
    name: foo
    state: present

- name: Install specific version of foo package
  community.general.pkgin:
    name: foo-2.0.1
    state: present

- name: Update cache and install foo package
  community.general.pkgin:
    name: foo
    update_cache: true

- name: Remove package foo
  community.general.pkgin:
    name: foo
    state: absent

- name: Remove packages foo and bar
  community.general.pkgin:
    name: foo,bar
    state: absent

- name: Update repositories as a separate step
  community.general.pkgin:
    update_cache: true

- name: Upgrade main packages (equivalent to pkgin upgrade)
  community.general.pkgin:
    upgrade: true

- name: Upgrade all packages (equivalent to pkgin full-upgrade)
  community.general.pkgin:
    full_upgrade: true

- name: Force-upgrade all packages (equivalent to pkgin -F full-upgrade)
  community.general.pkgin:
    full_upgrade: true
    force: true

- name: Clean packages cache (equivalent to pkgin clean)
  community.general.pkgin:
    clean: true
